description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for interacting with the Amazon WorkMail service. It provides method annotations for available operations and extends the generic AwsClient class.

classes.name: WorkMailClient
classes.description: A class representing the AWS WorkMail client, used to invoke operations on the Amazon WorkMail service.

methods.name: associateDelegateToResource
methods.description: Associates a delegate with a resource in WorkMail.

methods.name: associateDelegateToResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a delegate with a resource in WorkMail.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in WorkMail.

methods.name: createUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new user in WorkMail.
